The '''1954–55 [[Eliteserien|Hovedserien]]''' was the 11th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]].

==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams, and [[Larvik Turn & IF|Larvik Turn]] won the championship, their second league title.
